mentions.name: Sports Betting Odds over SMS
mentions.description: This service delivers sports betting odds over SMS text messages to users in the US. The builder has negotiated exemptions with mobile carriers, which have rules against providing betting advice or being affiliated with sportsbooks.
mentions.problem: US carriers have rules about providing betting advice or being affiliated with sportsbooks, so the builder had to work with carriers to get exemptions to run the service over SMS.
mentions.source_excerpt: Sports betting odds over sms (US only). I’ve had to work with carriers to get exemptions as they have rules about providing betting advice or being affiliated with sportsbooks, which has been interesting.
